not_yet_established.few_shot_energy_adapter_is_identified: Blocked until a population mechanism potential passes a source gate.
not_yet_established.orientation_or_typed_channels_are_requir: Plausible hypothesis requiring a held-out structural identifiability gate.
not_yet_established.p1b_has_lost_real_affinity_direction: Real affinity direction has not been tested; synthetic geometry is sufficient.
not_yet_established.reference_state_improves_affinity_direct: Requires a frozen marginal-matched decoy distribution and later affinity gate.
not_yet_established.residue_slot_pooling_erases_typed_energe: Plausible but no pooled-versus-explicit residue experiment exists.

semantic_corrections.adapter_identifiability: d <= k is necessary, not sufficient; support design rank and query row-space coverage are also required.
semantic_corrections.orthogonality: Cross-fitting prevents in-sample nuisance leakage but does not by itself establish Neyman orthogonality or causal interpretation.
semantic_corrections.potential_sign: The proposal's negative-log-ratio convention conflicts with its later positive-is-favorable convention and must be fixed before use.
semantic_corrections.statistical_potential: -log(p_bound/p_ref) is a reference-dependent structural log-density ratio, not binding free energy.
semantic_corrections.uncertainty: Taking an expected potential under p(distance) propagates an expectation; it does not preserve the full uncertainty law.
